Elements with the 'button' interactive role must have a tabindex value
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_interactive_supports_focus

Visible, non-interactive element `<i>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events
